definitions.gloss: dried gourd shavings, dried calabash strips
definitions.explanation: Thin strips of dried gourd (calabash) used as an ingredient in Japanese cuisine, especially in sushi rolls and simmered dishes.

examples.japanese: {干瓢|かんぴょう}{巻|ま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}する→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: To order a dried gourd sushi roll.

examples.japanese: {干瓢|かんぴょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧。
examples.english: Dried gourd strips are rehydrated in water before use.

examples.japanese: {栃木県|とちぎけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{干瓢|かんぴょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生産量|せいさんりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Tochigi Prefecture has the highest dried gourd production in Japan.

notes:
WRITING:
Usually written in kanji as {干瓢|かんぴょう} or in hiragana as かんぴょう.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{干瓢|かんぴょう} is made from the ⟦{夕顔|ゆうがお}→夕顔：28687_yuugao⟧ (bottle gourd) fruit, peeled into long strips and dried in the sun. It is a traditional ingredient in ⟦{巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし}→巻き寿司：12410_makizushi⟧ and ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧. {栃木県|とちぎけん} produces over 90% of Japan's {干瓢|かんぴょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {干瓢|かんぴょう}{巻|ま}き: dried gourd sushi roll
- {干瓢|かんぴょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧: simmered dried gourd
- {干瓢|かんぴょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧: to rehydrate dried gourd
